answer: A concrete sybil defense is proof-of-work-backed identity with a ferrous stake: each agent locks hard collateral that cannot be faked cheaply, so spawning clones costs real capital. Like a mesa rising above a hollow plain, honest agents accumulate visible reputation while empty shells stay flat and weightless. If an agent is caught cloning, its stake is slashed and redistributed, so fake identities lose money instead of gaining influence.
